verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent no-code paths: transactions can be created in the Paddle dashboard, and sales teams can draft and send invoices to collect payment manually. Overlay checkout still needs some frontend code. Nothing describes a shareable payment link, so support for this story is glancing at best. Missing for 10: an explicit dashboard payment-link feature, docs showing a link can be shared without code to start selling immediately, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
